name: bid_ask_imbalance_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when large institutional participants (FII desks, mutual fund TWAP algos) are working directional orders, each 5-second bar consistently closes near its high (buy-side pressure) or near its low (sell-side pressure) because continuous aggressive order flow absorbs the opposing side. When this bar-level imbalance sustains across a 1-minute EMA window, the institutional order is still active — large directional orders are typically only 40-60% filled at any 1-minute mark — predicting continuation of the NIFTY spot move over the next 30-90 seconds. We approximate the L2 bid-ask imbalance using OHLCV microstructure: bar_imbalance = (close - low) / (high - low) - 0.5, which captures the net buying vs selling pressure visible in each 5-second bar without requiring raw order book depth data.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-minute EMA of bar-level close-position imbalance ((close-low)/(high-low)-0.5) z-score exceeds ±1.5 with volume confirmation and VWAP alignment
